name: @bemedev/app-monorepo
description: A reprogramming method to code better

scripts.ci:
CIN=$(date +%s) && pnpm install && pnpm run rm:lib && pnpm run lint && pnpm run pretest && pnpm run test:only && pnpm run posttest && echo "
✅ CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CIN))s
"
scripts._ci:admin:
CI_ADMIN=$(date +%s) && pnpm run rm && pnpm run up && pnpm install && pnpm run _ci && pnpm install && echo "
✅ Admin CI takes $(($(date +%s) - CI_ADMIN))s
"
scripts.ci:admin:
FULL_CI=$(date +%s) && pnpm run ci && pnpm run _ci:admin && echo "
✅ Full CI takes $(($(date +%s) - FULL_CI))s
"
scripts.pnpm:devPreinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json')); const version=require('child_process').execSync('pnpm -v').toString().trim(); pkg.packageManager='pnpm@' + version; fs.writeFileSync('./package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');"
scripts.rinit: pnpm run rm && pnpm run config
scripts.rm: pnpm run rimraf -- node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml && pnpm clean --lockfile
